topic.title: Diffusion Dynamics and Efficient Generative Sampling
topic.area: Continuous Models and Scientific Machine Learning
topic.overview: Diffusion methods generate or sample data by following a stochastic process between a simple distribution and a complex target. This topic examines the mathematics and numerical implementation of that journey: score estimation, reverse transitions, differential-equation solvers, proximal operators, and conditional transport. Different formulations can change both computational cost and the distribution ultimately produced.
topic.whyItMatters: Generating a sample in fewer steps is useful only if the approximation preserves the desired distribution or perceptual properties. Theoretical distance bounds and empirical sample quality provide complementary evidence, and methods for known unnormalized densities need not require the same learned components as image generators.
topic.evolution: Early representatives study stochastic trajectories and diffusion-based inference. Recent work compares ordinary and stochastic generative dynamics and develops faster solvers. Proximal diffusion models in 2025 replace score-based forward discretization with learned proximal operations; a 2026 framework combines parallel tempering initialization with conditional diffusion transport without a neural approximation to its dynamics.
openQuestions: Which numerical errors most strongly affect sample diversity and fidelity?
When can analytic transport structure reduce the need for learned sampling dynamics?

papers.title: Mechanisms of Projective Composition of Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: The paper defines projective composition and analyzes when combining diffusion-model scores and sampling can achieve it.

papers.title: Neural Guided Diffusion Bridges
papers.tldr: A neural approximation of diffusion-bridge dynamics enables efficient independent sampling after training, including challenging rare-event and multimodal settings.

papers.title: Non-stationary Diffusion For Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.tldr: NsDiff incorporates time-varying uncertainty into diffusion forecasting through adaptive distributions and uncertainty-aware noise scheduling.

papers.title: Outsourced Diffusion Sampling: Efficient Posterior Inference in Latent Spaces of Generative Models
papers.tldr: Outsourced diffusion sampling learns posterior samplers in a generator's noise space, enabling conditional generation from existing unconditional models.

papers.title: Progressive Tempering Sampler with Diffusion
papers.tldr: The sampler trains diffusion models across temperatures, reusing and refining samples to improve target-evaluation efficiency over diffusion-based neural samplers.

papers.title: Provable Efficiency of Guidance in Diffusion Models for General Data Distribution
papers.tldr: For general data distributions, diffusion guidance can reduce the proportion of bad samples without improving every sample individually.

papers.title: S4S: Solving for a Fast Diffusion Model Solver
papers.tldr: S4S learns a diffusion sampling solver from a stronger teacher to improve sample quality with very few neural-network evaluations.

papers.title: SADA: Stability-guided Adaptive Diffusion Acceleration
papers.tldr: SADA uses numerical stability to adapt step and token sparsity, delivering reported speedups of at least 1.8 times with small fidelity losses.

papers.title: SDE Matching: Scalable and Simulation-Free Training of Latent Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.tldr: SDE Matching trains latent stochastic differential equations without numerical simulation, reporting comparable performance with substantially lower computational complexity.

papers.title: Simple and Critical Iterative Denoising: A Recasting of Discrete Diffusion in Graph Generation
papers.tldr: Simple Iterative Denoising changes noisy-state dependencies and adds selective Critic-guided revision to improve graph generation.

papers.title: SITCOM: Step-wise Triple-Consistent Diffusion Sampling For Inverse Problems
papers.tldr: SITCOM enforces three forms of consistency during diffusion reconstruction, reducing reverse steps while achieving competitive or better quality and runtime.

papers.title: Variational Control for Guidance in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Diffusion Trajectory Matching unifies guidance through variational control and yields a training-free method with strong inverse-problem results.

papers.title: A solvable model of learning generative diffusion: theory and insights
papers.tldr: A tractable generative-model analysis connects training-data quantity to generated distributions and explains how collapse can arise during synthetic-data retraining.

papers.title: Absorb and Converge: Provable Convergence Guarantee for Absorbing Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: The paper establishes convergence and finite-time error guarantees for absorbing discrete diffusion, including guarantees without early stopping under suitable assumptions.

papers.title: AccuQuant: Simulating Multiple Denoising Steps for Quantizing Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: AccuQuant calibrates quantized diffusion models across connected denoising steps to address accumulating errors with constant memory complexity.

papers.title: Adaptive Stochastic Coefficients for Accelerating Diffusion Sampling
papers.tldr: AdaSDE learns a per-step coefficient that adapts stochastic error correction to improve diffusion sampling with few function evaluations.

papers.title: Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Sampler
papers.tldr: ASBS trains diffusion samplers from energy functions using scalable matching objectives and supports arbitrary source distributions.

papers.title: Assessing the quality of denoising diffusion models in Wasserstein distance: noisy score and optimal bounds
papers.tldr: The paper quantifies diffusion models’ robustness to noisy score evaluations and derives faster Wasserstein-2 convergence bounds that match Gaussian-case rates.

papers.title: Beyond Scores: Proximal Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: ProxDM learns proximal operators for an alternative diffusion discretization with theoretical sampling guarantees and faster empirical convergence in few steps.

papers.title: CCS: Controllable and Constrained Sampling with Diffusion Models via Initial Noise Perturbation
papers.tldr: CCS uses a near-linear relationship between initial-noise changes and generated outputs to improve control over diffusion sampling.

papers.title: Constrained Posterior Sampling: Time Series Generation with Hard Constraints
papers.tldr: CPS incorporates constraint projections into diffusion sampling to generate realistic time series with many constraints and no additional training.

papers.title: Continuous Diffusion Model for Language Modeling
papers.tldr: A continuous diffusion model uses categorical-distribution geometry to outperform existing discrete diffusion methods and approach autoregressive performance.

papers.title: Cross-fluctuation phase transitions reveal sampling dynamics in diffusion models
papers.tldr: Cross-fluctuation statistics reveal sharp transitions in diffusion sampling, and detecting those transitions improves generation efficiency and two zero-shot tasks.

papers.title: Diffusion Federated Dataset
papers.tldr: The framework combines local diffusion distributions through cooperative sampling to generate synthetic data without exchanging model parameters.

papers.title: Diffusion Generative Modeling on Lie Group Representations
papers.tldr: Diffusion in Lie-group representation spaces provides a general transformation-aware framework and improves molecular generation and docking results over diffusion on the group itself.

papers.title: Diffusion Transformers for Imputation: Statistical Efficiency and Uncertainty Quantification
papers.tldr: The paper derives data-efficiency and uncertainty results for diffusion-transformer imputation and shows that missing-value patterns matter.

papers.title: Dimension-free Score Matching and Time Bootstrapping for Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: The paper proves nearly dimension-free score-learning bounds and proposes reusing learned scores to reduce variance across diffusion noise levels.

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Models: Novel Analysis and New Sampler Guarantees
papers.tldr: A new analysis strengthens discrete diffusion sampler guarantees and reduces tau-leaping bounds’ vocabulary dependence from quadratic to linear.

papers.title: Discrete Spatial Diffusion: Intensity-Preserving Diffusion Modeling
papers.tldr: DSD generates discrete spatial structures while exactly preserving particle counts throughout both forward and reverse diffusion.

papers.title: Elucidated Rolling Diffusion Models for Probabilistic Forecasting of Complex Dynamics
papers.tldr: ERDM adapts high-fidelity diffusion modeling to rolling forecasts, improving evaluated fluid and weather predictions while explicitly representing growing uncertainty.

papers.title: Fast Solvers for Discrete Diffusion Models: Theory and Applications of High-Order Algorithms
papers.tldr: Higher-order solvers improve discrete diffusion sampling, with a second-order accuracy guarantee and better reported quality at matched computational cost.

papers.title: Fractional Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.tldr: Fractional Diffusion Bridge Models incorporate temporal memory into tractable generative bridges and outperform Brownian baselines on two evaluated tasks.

papers.title: Generation as Search Operator for Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion-based Combinatorial Optimization
papers.tldr: GenSCO turns diffusion generation into a repeated search operation, improving inference-time scaling and achieving substantial reported routing-solver speedups.

papers.title: Guided Diffusion Sampling on Function Spaces with Applications to PDEs
papers.tldr: FunDPS combines function-space diffusion with observation guidance to reconstruct PDE solutions from sparse data across resolutions.

papers.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Flow Models via Stochastic Generation and Rollover Budget Forcing
papers.tldr: Stochastic generation and adaptive compute allocation enable more effective inference-time scaling for pretrained flow models.

papers.title: ItDPDM: Information-Theoretic Discrete Poisson Diffusion Model
papers.tldr: ItDPDM combines discrete-state diffusion with a reconstruction loss exactly related to likelihood, improving probability estimation and supporting competitive generation.

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Models as Energy Minimization
papers.tldr: An energy-minimization theory for masked diffusion motivates post-training schedule tuning that improves sampling, particularly with few steps.

papers.title: Multitask Learning with Stochastic Interpolants
papers.tldr: Operator-based stochastic interpolants generalize flow and diffusion dynamics to support several generative tasks without task-specific training.

papers.title: Neural Stochastic Flows: Solver-Free Modelling and Inference for SDE Solutions
papers.tldr: Neural Stochastic Flows learn SDE transition distributions for single-step sampling, achieving comparable reported accuracy with much lower computation.

papers.title: On scalable and efficient training of diffusion samplers
papers.tldr: A novelty-guided MCMC searcher and periodic reinitialization improve the exploration and training efficiency of diffusion samplers.

papers.title: One-Step Offline Distillation of Diffusion-based Models via Koopman Modeling
papers.tldr: KDM distills diffusion generation into one step by learning linear dynamics in a transformed space, with reported FID improvements of up to 40%.

papers.title: Progressive Inference-Time Annealing of Diffusion Models for Sampling from Boltzmann Densities
papers.tldr: PITA combines diffusion smoothing and progressive temperature annealing to sample molecular equilibrium distributions with fewer energy evaluations.

papers.title: Proper Hölder-Kullback Dirichlet Diffusion: A Framework for High Dimensional Generative Modeling
papers.tldr: A Dirichlet diffusion framework and new divergence objectives provide a non-Gaussian route to high-quality image generation.

papers.title: Remasking Discrete Diffusion Models with Inference-Time Scaling
papers.tldr: ReMDM lets pretrained masked diffusion models revise generated tokens, improving sample quality and enabling useful scaling with additional inference steps.

papers.title: Rethinking Losses for Diffusion Bridge Samplers
papers.tldr: Reverse-KL training with log-derivative gradients improves diffusion-bridge sampling and stability over Log Variance loss in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Reverse Diffusion Sequential Monte Carlo Samplers
papers.tldr: The proposed sequential Monte Carlo framework corrects diffusion-sampler biases and provides consistent sampling and unbiased normalization estimates under mild conditions.

papers.title: Sampling by averaging: A multiscale approach to score estimation
papers.tldr: Multiscale stochastic averaging estimates diffusion-path scores without training or inner-loop MCMC, yielding competitive sampling methods.

papers.title: Score-Based Diffusion Modeling for Nonparametric Empirical Bayes in Heteroscedastic Gaussian Mixtures
papers.tldr: A generalized diffusion framework learns latent distributions and denoises Gaussian observations with unequal noise, with theoretical error guarantees and empirical gains.

papers.title: Single-Step Operator Learning for Conditioned Time-Series Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Frequency-aware operator learning enables single-step time-series diffusion with competitive forecasting and imputation quality at lower inference cost.

papers.title: Spectral Analysis of Diffusion Models with Application to Schedule Design
papers.tldr: Under a Gaussianity assumption, a spectral analysis of diffusion inference yields data-dependent noise schedules and explains some scheduling heuristics.

papers.title: Split Gibbs Discrete Diffusion Posterior Sampling
papers.tldr: SGDD uses split Gibbs sampling to guide discrete diffusion models toward target posteriors for design, reconstruction, and infilling tasks.

papers.title: State Size Independent Statistical Error Bound for Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: The paper derives finite-data error bounds independent of state-space size for discrete diffusion models under specified geometric and graph conditions.

papers.title: Straight-Line Diffusion Model for Efficient 3D Molecular Generation
papers.tldr: SLDM uses a linear diffusion trajectory for three-dimensional molecular generation, reporting state-of-the-art performance and hundredfold better sampling efficiency.

papers.title: System-Embedded Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.tldr: Embedding known linear measurement structure into supervised diffusion bridges improves signal recovery and reported robustness to deployment-time system mismatch.

papers.title: TADA: Improved Diffusion Sampling with Training-free Augmented DynAmics
papers.tldr: TADA uses higher-dimensional noise and momentum-inspired dynamics to accelerate pretrained diffusion sampling while offering cost-free control over detail.

papers.title: Tortoise and Hare Guidance: Accelerating Diffusion Model Inference with Multirate Integration
papers.tldr: Tortoise and Hare Guidance accelerates diffusion sampling by evaluating approximation-tolerant guidance on a coarser timestep grid.

papers.title: Uni-Instruct: One-step Diffusion Model through Unified Diffusion Divergence Instruction
papers.tldr: Uni-Instruct unifies diffusion distillation methods and derives a tractable objective yielding strong one-step generation results.

papers.title: Why Masking Diffusion Works: Condition on the Jump Schedule for Improved Discrete Diffusion
papers.tldr: SCUD incorporates known jump-time distributions into discrete diffusion, enabling structured models that outperform masking diffusion in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: A random matrix analysis explains much cross-split diffusion consistency through shared Gaussian statistics and predicts how finite data affect generated outputs.

papers.title: Are First-Order Diffusion Samplers Really Slower? A Fast Forward-Value Approach
papers.tldr: A training-free first-order diffusion sampler improves low-budget generation by changing where model evaluations occur along the sampling trajectory.

papers.title: Beyond Continuity: Simulation-free Reconstruction of Discrete Branching Dynamics from Single-cell Snapshots
papers.tldr: USB learns cellular trajectories from snapshots while explicitly modeling random movement and discrete cell birth and death.

papers.title: Branching Diffusion for Point Processes in Time and Space
papers.tldr: A branching diffusion model generates complete event sets by learning both event movement and changes in event count.

papers.title: Bridge Matching Sampler: Scalable Sampling via Generalized Fixed-Point Diffusion Matching
papers.tldr: Bridge Matching Sampler learns flexible diffusion transports with a stable objective and regularization that helps preserve sampling diversity.

papers.title: Categorical Reparameterization with Denoising Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: ReDGE uses diffusion-based soft reparameterization to estimate gradients through categorical choices, matching or improving on existing methods in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Conditional Diffusion Sampling
papers.tldr: Conditional Diffusion Sampling combines Parallel Tempering with exact diffusion transport to potentially improve sampling efficiency without neural training.

papers.title: Consistent Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: Discrete posterior-bridge consistency trains diffusion language models for stronger few-step generation without a pretrained teacher.

papers.title: Corrected Samplers for Discrete Flow Models
papers.tldr: Two corrected discrete-flow samplers reduce numerical error at little extra cost, with theoretical and empirical efficiency improvements.

papers.title: Diff-MN: Diffusion Parameterized MoE-NCDE for Continuous Time Series Generation with Irregular Observations
papers.tldr: Diff-MN generates continuous time series from irregular observations by using diffusion to produce sample-specific temporal dynamics.

papers.title: Diffusion Differentiable Resampling
papers.tldr: A training-free diffusion surrogate enables differentiable particle resampling with a consistency proof and strong empirical results.

papers.title: Dimension-free convergence of diffusion models for approximate Gaussian mixtures
papers.tldr: For distributions well approximated by Gaussian mixtures, DDPM has an iteration bound independent of dimension and mixture size up to logarithmic factors.

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Samplers and Bridges: Off-Policy Algorithms and Applications in Latent Spaces
papers.tldr: Off-policy training improves discrete diffusion samplers, while new bridge formulations extend them to distribution matching and latent-space posterior sampling.

papers.title: "Do Diffusion Models Dream of Electric Planes?" Discrete and Continuous Simulation-Based Inference for Aircraft Design
papers.tldr: A hierarchical diffusion model generates aircraft configurations and their continuous parameters through simulation-based inference.

papers.title: Efficient Diffusion Models under Nonconvex Equality and Inequality constraints via Landing
papers.tldr: A landing mechanism makes constrained diffusion more efficient while maintaining feasibility under nonconvex equality and inequality constraints.

papers.title: Efficient Diffusion Models via Time Step Optimization with Consistent Training and Inference Constraints
papers.tldr: Probabilistic timestep selection and lightweight retraining jointly improve diffusion sampling efficiency and generation quality in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: Error Analysis of Discrete Flow with Generator Matching
papers.tldr: A unified analysis bounds discrete-flow estimation and early-stopping errors, with nearly optimal sample-size convergence under an additional boundedness condition.

papers.title: Expanding the Chaos: Neural Operator for Stochastic (Partial) Differential Equations
papers.tldr: The method combines structured expansions of random noise with neural operators to learn stochastic differential-equation solutions across multiple domains.

papers.title: Fast and Scalable Analytical Diffusion

papers.title: FeRA: Frequency-Energy Constrained Routing for Effective Diffusion Adaptation Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: FeRA adapts diffusion models by routing among frequency-specific adapters according to the latent representation's changing energy distribution.

papers.title: Flow Sampling : Learning to Sample from Unnormalized Densities via Denoising Conditional Processes
papers.tldr: Flow Sampling learns samplers directly from energy functions while reducing training evaluations and extending diffusion-based sampling to curved spaces.

papers.title: Functional Adjoint Sampler: Scalable Sampling on Infinite Dimensional Spaces
papers.tldr: The Functional Adjoint Sampler extends control-based diffusion sampling to function spaces and improves reported transition path sampling performance.

papers.title: Generalization Bounds for Discrete Diffusion: Statistical Advantage of Masking
papers.tldr: The paper derives bounds showing how masking can exploit effective data support and sequence structure in discrete diffusion learning.

papers.title: Generative Neural Operators through Diffusion Last Layer
papers.tldr: DLL adds diffusion over compact field coefficients to neural operators, enabling uncertainty estimates and improving reported rollout stability.

papers.title: High-accuracy and dimension-free sampling with diffusions
papers.tldr: A new diffusion solver achieves polylogarithmic iteration dependence on inverse accuracy, with dimensional effects entering only through an effective support radius.

papers.title: Infinite-Dimensional Generative Diffusions via Doob’s h-Transform
papers.tldr: Doob's h-transform provides a rigorous, score-matchable construction of generative diffusions that extends to infinite dimensions.

papers.title: Inverting Data Transformations via Diffusion Sampling
papers.tldr: TIED samples corrective transformations on Lie groups to restore transformed inputs and improve pretrained-model robustness at test time.

papers.title: Is Your Diffusion Sampler Actually Correct? A Sampler-Centric Evaluation of Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: An exact-denoiser evaluation shows that few-step discrete diffusion sampling can distort the intended distribution despite improved standard metrics.

papers.title: Learning Permutation Distributions via Reflected Diffusion on Ranks
papers.tldr: Soft-Rank Diffusion learns permutation distributions using smoother rank-based corruption and more expressive sequential denoisers.

papers.title: Likelihood Matching for Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Likelihood Matching trains diffusion models through Gaussian approximations of reverse transitions and provides estimation and sampling guarantees.

papers.title: M-Star: Markovian Projection of Star-Shaped Diffusion for Exponential Family Distributions
papers.tldr: M-Star learns a Markovian projection of star-shaped diffusion, supporting broader distribution families and distillation for few-step or single-step generation.

papers.title: Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector for Stabilizing Latent Diffusion Inverse Problem Solvers
papers.tldr: MCLC stabilizes latent-diffusion inverse solvers through measurement-consistent updates that reduce their mismatch with learned reverse-diffusion dynamics.

papers.title: Mitigating the Contractivity Trap in Diffusion ODEs via Stein Stabilization
papers.tldr: SteinDiff applies reference-free, geometry-aware corrections to improve diffusion generation with large sampling steps.

papers.title: Modeling Temporal scRNA-seq Data with Latent Gaussian Process and Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: A latent Gaussian-process model with optimal transport reconstructs temporal cell-population changes while explicitly accounting for asynchronous progression and cell types.

papers.title: Overclocking Electrostatic Generative Models
papers.tldr: Inverse Poisson Flow Matching distills electrostatic generators into fast samplers that achieve near-teacher or better image quality.

papers.title: Particle-Guided Diffusion Models for Partial Differential Equations
papers.tldr: Physics-guided diffusion sampling within a Sequential Monte Carlo framework produces PDE solution fields with lower reported numerical error.

papers.title: PerturbDiff: Functional Diffusion for Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
papers.tldr: PerturbDiff generates distributions of cellular responses to capture hidden population-level variability and improve prediction of unseen perturbations.

papers.title: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models in Spectral Space
papers.tldr: Spectral-space diffusion combines learned PDE distributions with inference-time physics constraints to improve solution accuracy and computational efficiency.

papers.title: Physics-Informed Distillation of Diffusion Models for PDE-Constrained Generation
papers.tldr: PIDDM distills diffusion models into single-step generators that improve both sample accuracy and satisfaction of physical equations.

papers.title: Rex: A Family of Reversible Exponential (Stochastic) Runge-Kutta Solvers
papers.tldr: Rex converts explicit Runge-Kutta methods into reversible ODE and SDE solvers, achieving near-machine-precision reconstruction in experiments.

papers.title: Simple Approximation and Derivative Free Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models via Sequential Monte Carlo on Path Measures
papers.tldr: URGE guides diffusion sampling through derivative-free trajectory weighting and resampling, with a theoretical link to unbiased particle-based schemes.

papers.title: Sobolev Regularized Score Difference Estimation in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Sobolev regularization enables a consistent, scalable score-difference estimator with improved small-sample stability and demonstrated benefits for ECG generation transfer.

papers.title: Supervised Guidance Training for Infinite-Dimensional Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Under stated prior assumptions, Supervised Guidance Training enables function-space diffusion models to learn posterior-sampling guidance.

papers.title: Support-Proximity Augmented Diffusion Estimation for Offline Black-Box Optimization
papers.tldr: SPADE combines diffusion-based score prediction with data-support regularization to improve offline design optimization.

papers.title: SURGE: Approximation and Training Free Particle Filter for Diffusion Surrogate
papers.tldr: SURGE uses importance weighting and resampling over diffusion trajectories to correct observation-guided forecasts toward the desired posterior.

papers.title: Tensor Train Diffusion: Leveraging Low-Rank Structures for High-Dimensional Score-Based Sampling
papers.tldr: Tensor Train Diffusion combines compact low-rank function representations with a backward-time solver for efficient high-dimensional sampling.

papers.title: The Accumulation of Score Estimation Error in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: The paper bounds how score-estimation errors accumulate in diffusion sampling and shows when regularity prevents a small-time curvature blow-up.

papers.title: Tightening the Score Matching Gap for Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Tighter diffusion-model error bounds exploit score-estimator regularity and suggest that low-noise score accuracy matters more for closing the score-matching gap.

papers.title: Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle: A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: A geometric framework locates heightened diffusion-model memorization risk at medium noise levels and motivates a targeted mitigating intervention.

papers.title: Why DDIM Hallucinates More Than DDPM: A Theoretical Analysis of Reverse Dynamics
papers.tldr: For a Gaussian mixture target, stochasticity helps diffusion trajectories escape a region where deterministic DDIM can become trapped.
